messages:
marie: Heads up — VoiceOver on macOS + Safari is reading our filter toolbar oddly: it announces each item as 'button' twice and the focus order is non-linear. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/voiceover-dup.png alex: repro'd it. Steps: open Projects dashboard > open Filters > tab through. VoiceOver reads: 'Status button, Status button, selected' — happens with keyboard only too. :eyes: jon: likely a roving tabindex / aria role mix. I remember we used role="group" around the filter chip set and gave each chip a tabindex=0. If we leave multiple tabbable descendants the SR may double-announce. sam: design perspective: we want keyboard nav to land on chips and use arrow keys to move selection (roving pattern). Also noticed the focus ring is nearly invisible in dark theme — contrast for the outline is <3:1. marie: agree on arrow nav. Proposal: make the chip container a role="listbox" and each chip role="option" with aria-selected. That maps nicely to VO and arrow-key expectations. jon: quick patch idea (pseudo): ```
``` then implement roving tabindex logic so only the active option has tabindex=0. alex: that sounds good. Also add aria-live for the count update when filters change so VO announces results (e.g., "Showing 12 projects"). Right now counts update silently. sam: for the focus ring contrast: current ring color is rgba(255,255,255,0.12) on dark — too faint. Suggest swapping to `outline: 2px solid var(--interactive-contrast)` or use `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`? prefer solid 2px for clarity. marie: prefer a solid 2px with >=3:1 contrast vs background per WCAG AA for non-text focus. Can we pick #BEE3FF on dark bg? That hits ~4.1:1. jon: will update styles. Also will add role changes and roving tabindex in the same PR. Planning to add a Storybook story and a small Axe test. alex: I'll add an e2e check: run with VoiceOver mock and axe-core snapshot in CI. For now I captured Axe results locally: 2 violations (color-contrast on focus, duplicate interactive nodes). marie: great — can we include voiceover steps in the PR description so reviewers can quickly validate on mac? Something like: 'Open Safari > Cmd+F5 to start VO and Tab into Filters' and include exact expected readout. jon: will do. I can also include this snippet for the live count: `
Showing 12 projects
` sam: thanks — tiny copy nit: when filter is active the chip label reads "Open (3)" — screen reader reads the parentheses. Prefer `Open, 3 results` via visually-hidden comma for clearer voice rendering. marie: good call. Also add `aria-label="Open, 3 results"` on the option to be explicit. a11y-bot: Lighthouse accessibility snapshot: 92 -> 97 after suggested changes (simulated). Axe: duplicate interactive node violation reduced. :white_check_mark: jon: I'll open PR by EOD with tests + Storybook. Assigning to @sam for UX sign-off and @alex for QA. marie: thank you! this will improve a lot for keyboard and screen reader users. :heart:
